title: Sept. 21 lotto draw: No winner of ₱214.44M jackpot
summary: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱214.44 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱67.37 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office draws on Monday, Sept. 21.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱214.44 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱67.37 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office draws on Monday, Sept. 21. The date fell on a Monday, when Grand Lotto 6/55 and Mega Lotto 6/45 are among the major games scheduled for drawing. Time and Date
